items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: The Starter plan is free forever for 1 shop. The Pro plan includes a free trial with no credit card — you only pay if you decide to continue.

items.q: Does GestionPro work with a slow connection?
items.a: Yes. The app is optimized for unstable 3G/4G networks with smooth data loading and compressed network exchanges. Your data stays secure and accessible.

items.q: Can I use it on my phone?
items.a: The dashboard and POS are fully mobile. Touch targets ≥ 44 px, side drawers, sticky actions — designed first for smartphone, then adapted to desktop.
CFA Franc (XOF) by default, Euro (EUR) and US Dollar (USD) as needed. You can set the currency per shop, and consolidated reports are available in the currency of your choice.
TLS encryption for all communications, automatic daily backups, strict isolation per shop and per account. No third-party access to your data. GDPR compliance for European users.
Yes, anytime, at no cost. Upgrades are immediate; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle. No data loss when switching.

faqs.q: How do I create my first shop on GestionPro?
faqs.a: After signing up, click 'Create a shop' from your central dashboard. Enter your shop name, choose your currency (CFA Franc by default for the WAEMU zone), then select your business sector from our extensive list. Your management workspace is set up instantly!

faqs.q: Can I manage several physical shops with a single account?
faqs.a: Yes! GestionPro's Premium plan lets you run up to 5 distinct shops from a single account. You can switch between shops in one click from the dropdown menu at the top of your dashboard, without signing in again.

faqs.q: How does the low-stock alert system work?
faqs.a: For each product added to your catalog, you can set an 'Alert threshold'. As soon as the available stock quantity is at or below this threshold after sales, a red visual notification appears on your dashboard to help you avoid stock-outs.

faqs.q: Can I import my product catalog from an Excel file?
faqs.a: Absolutely. From the 'Stock' module, click 'Import' and download our standard Excel/CSV file template. Fill in the columns (Name, Purchase price, Sale price, Quantity, Threshold) then import it to set up your entire catalog in seconds.

faqs.q: How do I enable automatic WAEMU VAT calculation at 18%?
faqs.a: When creating your invoices or quotes, check the 'Apply VAT (18%)' option. Our algorithm instantly calculates the pre-tax amount, the VAT amount and the total incl. tax in CFA Francs, ensuring full compliance with current tax regulations.

faqs.q: Can I export my invoices and expenses for my accountant?
faqs.a: Yes, all your sales journals, issued invoices and recorded expenses are exportable in one click in standard Excel/CSV or PDF format. These documents are structured to simplify your month-end bookkeeping.

faqs.q: How is my online shop created?
faqs.a: As soon as you add products to your catalog and enable the 'Online shop' option, GestionPro automatically generates a public e-commerce website for your brand. Your local customers can browse your products, fill their cart and submit orders directly to your WhatsApp!

faqs.q: How do I link my own custom domain name?
faqs.a: Premium subscribers can connect their own domain name (e.g. myshop.com). Go to Settings > E-shop, enter your domain name then configure the indicated DNS records (CNAME and A). Our team handles the free SSL certificate setup within 24h.
